description: 20â€“30 second vertical podcast excerpt; clarity and natural rhythm first.

pacing: Select a self-contained hook, claim, and payoff. Target 24â€“27 seconds; accept 20â€“30. Never pad or speed speech to hit duration.
Preserve original wording, chronological order, negations, qualifiers and the speakerâ€™s meaning. Prefer omission of effects over visual clutter.
Keep deliberate micro-pauses and breaths when they carry meaning. If a safe 20â€“30 second excerpt is impossible, return a planning failure outside this edit-plan contract.

silence_removal.candidate_condition: No speech in a versioned VAD analysis AND RMS below max(-50 dBFS, measured noise floor + 6 dB). VAD/RMS are planning evidence, never permission to cut through phonemes.
silence_removal.rule: Only shorten safe silence candidates. Keep a longer rhetorical pause when shortening damages cadence. Inspect breaths, laughter, crosstalk and word alignment. Do not automatically remove all low-energy audio.
silence_removal.rounding: Map safe kept boundaries outward to source frames: floor incoming start, ceil outgoing end. Retest remaining gap and guards after quantization.

cuts: Hard cuts only; at most six internal cuts. No cut through a word, breath onset, meaningful reaction, or syllable.
Remove dead space using omitted source ranges between kept segments; do not emit a second remove operation.
Keep source audio/video locked at 1x speed. No reordered, repeated or synthesized words. Consolidate source-contiguous segments.
punch_ins: Use zero to three purposeful emphasis events, normally 1.06â€“1.10x, never over 1.12x.
Ramp from 1.0x over at least six frames, hold, and return to 1.0x over at least six frames. Center on the base crop.
No punch spanning a cut, overlapping B-roll, or hiding a face/gesture. Space starts by at least five seconds.
captions: Faithful spoken wording, including qualifiers; punctuation is allowed. Do not invent or paraphrase dialogue.
Group one to three words into fast short phrases, at most two lines. Keep an unusually long word alone. Word-level active highlighting is driven by explicit timings.
Highlight at most one selected keyword per cue and at most 20% of words overall. Zero emphasis is valid.
Retiming maps source word bounds through the cut map. Never display a removed word. Inspect word alignment within two frames.
editorial_rules.b_roll: Use one or two 4-5 second cinematic B-roll inserts with visible motion. Return to the podcast between inserts. Captions pause during each insert and resume afterward.
music: Optional single instrumental bed with no distracting vocals, busy percussion or dramatic drops.
Approved audio preprocessed to -16 LUFS integrated and <= -1 dBTP. Speech is separately normalized to the same reference before mixing.
Explicit gain envelope, never louder than -28 dB relative to the normalized bed. Use -30 to -34 dB as a starting point.
Cover the entire clip with 0.5â€“1.0 second fades to/from digital mute. No loops, beat detection, automatic ducking or sidechain defaults in v1.
Listen to the final mix; this conservative bed level does not by itself guarantee intelligibility.
sfx: Zero or one approved sound at the first B-roll start. At most 0.8 seconds; use the saved sound-effect gain, up to +10 dB.
At least two-frame fades at each edge. No effect on every word, repeated whooshes or startling transients.
transitions: Hard cuts between all shots. Explicit transition array must be empty for this profile. No dissolves, wipes, glitches or flashes.
framing: One explicit static crop per kept segment. Crop must fit the source and exactly match output 9:16 aspect ratio.
Keep eyes near the upper third, protect face/headroom and meaningful hand gestures. Crop must remain safe through the entire segment.
Do not guess a crop for moving or off-center subjects. If static framing cannot preserve the subject, request review or replan; tracking is outside v1.
effect_budget: Count punch-ins, B-roll entries, SFX and overlays together: at most five decorations per clip; starts at least one second apart.
Captions, base crops, hard cuts, and the continuous music bed do not count as decorations. Budgets are ceilings, not quotas.
At most one visual decoration active: punch-in OR B-roll OR text overlay. SFX may accompany a visual event subject to start spacing.

podcast_dynamic_v1.line_break: greedy whitespace wrap to measured glyph width; fail if more than two lines; never auto-shrink
podcast_dynamic_v1.timing: Whole cue visible on [start,end); highlight word only on its [start,end). No active word in timing gaps.

release_requirements: Pin exact font bytes and shaping/rasterization implementation in a renderer capability manifest before production acceptance.
Freeze this profile version and asset-normalization recipe together; changed values require a new profile version.
All automatic checks plus source-word, framing, licensing and final-mix review must pass. Fake examples are structural fixtures, not renderable media.
